activity.role: Daimyo and head of the Date
activity.notes: Date Masamune became the 17th head of the Date in 1584 and rapidly expanded an autonomous Sengoku territorial authority in Ōshū. In 1590 he submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi during the latter's national unification. Consistent with ATLAS treatment of Oda, Uesugi and Shimazu, the Date clan itself is not treated as a state; this Activity represents Masamune's pre-Toyotomi territorial authority.

sources.title: 伊達市と伊達氏 — 福島県伊達市
sources.citation_text: Date City records that Masamune received the Date headship in 1584 and had expanded Date territory widely by 1589.
